storyline.label: Claude Mods
storyline.latest_title: DeepSeek Harness challenges Agent lock-in with Claude Code Mods bridge and open plugin architecture

prior_narrative.tldr: On Oct 1, Anthropic's Claude Code team published a guide to mods: hooks that ship inside plugins and run within a Claude Code session. The guide builds one from an empty folder, then tours two larger mods.
prior_narrative.whats_new: DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-alpha.1 (Oct 4) adds an experimental compatibility layer for Claude Code mods, and DeepSeek denies it is "copying homework".
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Mods are a plugin-level extension point, so a second agent runtime accepting the same format lowers the cost of moving mod-based workflows between harnesses.

status.detail: Claude Code mods have an official guide and now an experimental third-party compatibility layer in DeepSeek Harness.

beats.headline: Claude Code mods guide: hooks shipped inside plugins
beats.summary: Walks through building a mod from an empty folder and two larger examples.

beats.headline: DeepSeek Harness adds an experimental mods compatibility layer
beats.summary: Alpha release, with DeepSeek rejecting the "copying homework" charge.

open_questions: Does the Harness compatibility layer run existing Claude Code mods unmodified, or only a subset of hooks?
Will Anthropic document mods as a stable cross-runtime format, or keep them Claude Code specific?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: If you build Claude Code mods, keep hook logic free of Claude-specific paths for now; test against the Harness alpha only on throwaway projects until its coverage is documented.

day_captions.4a6aa459c4c33d53: Official how-to defining mods as hooks that ship in plugins.
day_captions.e281dcdde92c5175: Pandaily-reported Harness v0.2.1-alpha.1: first third-party runtime to ship a mods compatibility layer, flagged experimental.
day_captions.e8099ac11401f85a: Adds DeepSeek's denial of the "copying homework" allegation.
